newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle thin at $110/dressed - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle thin at $110/dressed - USDA.

text.p: Trading on slaughter steers and heifers was at a typical Monday standoff, USDA said.
Buyer inquiry was fairly strong. Seller interest light at the present bids, as most have cattle priced $112.00 and up per cwt on a dressed basis.
Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink. Dressed basis delivered ( paid on hot carcass weights).
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1200-1250 lbs - load 68.50; couple loads 110.00.
Slaughter heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1075-1125 lbs - few loads 110.00.
For week - 1,300 Sm Pd Lst Wk- 1,800 Sm Pd Lst Yr- 6,000
